The manifest_digest binds every entry and threshold: ANY byte change voids thresholds. 8a2f baseline stays frozen. WP-14 telemetry re-pin: stream_train.py (mlflow/sampler/profiler hooks) + run_config.py (telemetry section); thresholds stay blank-null. Desync re-pin: rust_observations.py entry removed (module deleted, plane feed supersedes); stream_train.py (device-gate validators, hot scalars, chunked workers, YAML feed knobs) + run_config.py (decode_prefetch/expand_batch_games/fetch_prefetch_depth); thresholds stay blank-null. Slice-E re-pin 2026-09-12: stream_train.py (homogeneous-buckets grouping, entry pins, ring depth 3, lint/format) + run_config.py (homogeneous_buckets flag, lint/format); thresholds stay blank-null. Shrink re-pin: tests/unit/test_rust_stream_wp14.py + tests/unit/test_replay_backend_wp14.py entries refreshed for the fixture sys.modules-pop fix (hard-delegate cutover, no fallback); thresholds stay blank-null. Wave 3 re-pin: training/stream_train.py entry refreshed for the loop-counting bridge cutover (counting oracle tails deleted, bridge-direct fail-closed); thresholds stay blank-null. Speed-wave re-pin: tests/unit/test_rust_stream_wp14.py + tests/unit/test_replay_backend_wp14.py entries refreshed for the shared import-only rust_extension fixture cutover (module-duplicate fixtures deleted); thresholds stay blank-null. Deletion-wave re-pin: models/schema.py + models/encoder.py entries refreshed for translator deletion (make_digest_text -> bridge-direct, byte-identical); parity gates file entry refreshed for the observation facade -> observation_types import migration; thresholds stay blank-null. Harden re-pin: training shell facades deleted (loop/replay/objectives/dataset/run_config/distill + distillation/teacher + analysis/qualification -> split modules), import retargets only; run_config entry dropped; thresholds untouched. Dead-code re-pin: models/schema dead envelope helpers removed; thresholds untouched. Encoder re-pin: additive Rust-handoff wrapper (oracle default unchanged); thresholds untouched. Dead-code re-pin: unused Rust-handoff wrapper chain removed from encoder; thresholds untouched. Encoder-cutover re-pin: models/encoder.py entry refreshed for the Rust-first bulk-fill cutover (stage_encoder_batch bridge path plus ImportError-only oracle twin, parity-proven bit-identical); thresholds stay blank-null. Oracle-removal re-pin: models/encoder.py entry refreshed for the Rust-only encoder cutover (numpy oracle fill deleted, bridge required); thresholds stay blank-null. Backend-removal re-pin: python/hydra2/training/stream_train.py entry refreshed (replay_backend rust-only, oracle dispatch deleted); thresholds stay blank-null.
